text_block_list.text:
After being defeated in the Satsuki Sho,
Biwa
Hayahide decides to recalculate
her equation
from scratch.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, Нарита Таисин's extraordinary

determination—the destabilizing
factor—won't be
easy to account for.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Уиннинг Тикит shouts her
resolve to
win the Japanese Derby at the
top of her lungs,
almost as if to convince
herself.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Can we rebuild Бива Хаяхидэ's winning
equation
in time for the Japanese Derby,
where both of her
indomitable rivals will
be?
text_block_list.name: Монолог
